title: The Swapped Lemon Tart
scene: At 2:15 PM, judges found the prize lemon tart swapped for a store pie. The dessert tent was empty from 2:00 to 2:15 PM.

suspects.name: Clara Finch
suspects.testimony: I was in the greenhouse potting herbs from 2:00 to 2:20 PM, and Owen was right beside me the whole time.
suspects.contradiction: Tessa's greenhouse log and a smudge of lemon curd on Clara's apron confirm she was in the tent.

suspects.name: Owen Marsh
suspects.testimony: I was in the greenhouse from 2:00 to 2:20 PM, completely alone; Clara never came in.
suspects.alibiProof: The greenhouse sign-in sheet and Tessa's photo at 2:10 PM show Owen working alone inside.

suspects.name: Tessa Bloom
suspects.testimony: I watered ferns outside the greenhouse window from 2:00 to 2:20 PM; only Owen was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: The garden watering timer and a visitor's snapshot confirm Tessa was by the window from 2:00 to 2:20 PM.

suspects.name: Milo Grant
suspects.testimony: I tallied scorecards in the gazebo from 2:00 to 2:15 PM, glancing toward the dessert tent twice.
suspects.alibiProof: Two other judges sat with Milo in the gazebo from 2:00 to 2:15 PM while he tallied scores.
